source_of_truth: Nuxt 4 app, .frontend-audit.json allows only catalog -> inventory. BOTH app/features/orders/useOrders.ts:1 and app/features/catalog/useCatalog.ts:2 import from ~/features/inventory/types, an internal file, while app/features/inventory/index.ts re-exports StockLevel — so each is a feature-internal-import (bypasses the public index), confirmed. Severity differs by import kind: orders' is `import type` (compile-time), catalog's is a runtime import.

expected.rationale: imports inventory's internal types file, not its public index.ts (type-only; compile-time coupling).
imports inventory's internal types file at runtime, bypassing the public index.ts.
